rows.metric_en: Maximum relative gm error on 78 retained transfer-grid probes
rows.metric_zh: 原转移曲线78个探针点的最大gm相对误差
rows.reference_en: 75-digit Decimal current with independent centered derivative h=1e-16 V; 26 gate points at each of -40/25/125 C.
rows.reference_zh: 75位Decimal电流与独立中心差分h=1e-16V；三个温度各26个栅压点。
rows.limits_en: Accuracy of the existing interpolation's derivative only; no device/PDK accuracy gain or added physics.
rows.limits_zh: 仅提升既有插值公式的导数计算精度，不代表器件/PDK准确度或新增物理机制。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Unit relative derivative scale; audited transfer probes avoid near-cancelling forward/reverse terms.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。单位相对导数尺度；审计的转移探针点不涉及正反项近相消。

rows.metric_en: Maximum relative charge error in a near-zero numerical stress test
rows.metric_zh: 近零电压数值压力测试的最大电荷相对误差
rows.reference_en: 70-digit Decimal evaluation of the original charge equation; 294 probes, |Vj|=1e-18 to 1e-6 V, both polarities and three temperatures.
rows.reference_zh: 原电荷方程的70位Decimal参考；294个探针点，|Vj|=1e-18至1e-6V，正负两种极性及三个温度。
rows.limits_en: Stress-test range is explicitly separate from the original plotted CV sweep; eliminates cancellation, not an across-the-board measured capacitance improvement.
rows.limits_zh: 压力测试电压范围与原绘制的CV扫描明确分开；消除数值相消，不表示全部实测电容精度提高。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Unit relative charge scale; rationalized near-zero denominator remains approximately two.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。单位相对电荷尺度；有理化后近零分母约为2。

rows.metric_zh: 最大归一化端口KCL残差
rows.reference_en: Exact Ebers-Moll terminal-current conservation: Ic+Ib+Ie=0.
rows.reference_zh: Ebers-Moll三端电流守恒精确关系：Ic+Ib+Ie=0。
rows.limits_en: Existing closed-form expm1 evaluation is retained; residual is at floating-point scale. No numerical improvement percentage is assigned.
rows.limits_zh: 保留既有expm1解析计算；残差已在浮点精度量级，不赋予数值提升百分比。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Terminal-current conservation is normalized by the largest terminal current.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。端口电流守恒残差按最大端口电流归一化。

rows.metric_en: Asymptotic relative sampling SE of estimated Gaussian pair sigma
rows.metric_zh: 高斯配对标准差估计的渐近相对抽样标准误
rows.reference_en: Delta-method approximation SE(s)/sigma≈1/sqrt(2(N-1)); fourfold samples. This is a sampling-uncertainty estimate, not a deterministic error.
rows.reference_zh: Delta方法近似SE(s)/sigma≈1/sqrt(2(N-1))；样本量增至四倍。此为抽样不确定度估计，不是确定性误差。
rows.limits_en: Reported separately from numerical accuracy. A single realized sigma estimate may move either direction; no foundry statistics or yield improvement.
rows.limits_zh: 与数值准确度分开报告；单次标准差估计可能向任一方向变化，不代表工艺统计或良率改善。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Asymptotic Gaussian sampling-SE formula for the declared sample counts; no deterministic numerical-error floor applies. Not a confidence interval for the realized sample sigma.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 针对声明样本量的渐近高斯抽样标准误公式；不适用确定性数值误差下限，也不是实得样本标准差的置信区间。

rows.metric_zh: 理想尾电流最大相对残差
rows.reference_en: Exact tail condition I1+I2=100 uA on all 1203 saved bias points.
rows.reference_zh: 1203个保存偏置点满足精确尾电流条件I1+I2=100μA。
rows.limits_en: 80 bisection steps already reach double-precision resolution; retained unchanged, no fabricated 10% gain.
rows.limits_zh: 80次二分已达到双精度分辨率，保持不变，不虚构10%提升。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Tail-current residual is normalized by the largest terminal current, 100 uA.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。尾电流残差按最大端口电流100μA归一化。

rows.metric_en: Maximum reference-voltage error against simplified analytic sum
rows.metric_zh: 相对简化解析合成式的最大基准电压误差
rows.reference_en: 70-digit Decimal identity Vref=Vg0+3(k/q)T[1-ln(T/T0)], 34 temperatures.
rows.reference_zh: 70位Decimal恒等式Vref=Vg0+3(k/q)T[1-ln(T/T0)]，34个温度点。
rows.limits_en: Existing analytic evaluation is already at floating-point floor; temperature curvature and physical assumptions are unchanged.
rows.limits_zh: 原解析计算已处于浮点精度下限，温度曲率及物理假设不变。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Maximum saved reference voltage sets the voltage scale.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。以保存的最大基准电压作为电压尺度。

rows.metric_en: Maximum RMS noise integration error across six band integrals
rows.metric_zh: 六个带内积分的最大噪声均方根误差
rows.reference_en: 70-digit evaluation of elementary PSD antiderivatives over 1 Hz–1 MHz; both spectra and all three temperatures.
rows.reference_zh: 1Hz至1MHz PSD初等原函数的70位参考；两个频谱与三个温度。
rows.limits_en: Saved PSD grid is unchanged; metric integration is analytic. No transistor noise, aliasing or measured amplifier calibration is added.
rows.limits_zh: 保存的PSD网格不变，指标积分改为解析式；未增加晶体管噪声、混叠或实测放大器校准。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Largest RMS value among the six positive band integrals sets the voltage scale.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。以六个正值带内积分中的最大均方根电压作为尺度。

rows.metric_en: Maximum absolute DNL of the ideal SAR
rows.metric_zh: 理想SAR的最大绝对DNL
rows.reference_en: Ideal binary CDAC transition widths equal one LSB, hence DNL=0.
rows.reference_zh: 理想二进制CDAC转换码宽为一个LSB，因此DNL=0。
rows.limits_en: Sequential-decision search and coherent FFT retained. Existing 60-step thresholds are at machine precision; no ENOB/physical accuracy gain is asserted.
rows.limits_zh: 保留逐次判决搜索与相干FFT，原60次边界搜索已达机器精度；不声称ENOB或实物准确度提升。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Full-scale binary64 voltage rounding converts to 1024 LSB units for a 10-bit ADC.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。10位ADC满量程双精度电压舍入换算为1024LSB尺度。

rows.metric_zh: 最大单位增益交越频率误差
rows.reference_en: 70-digit positive root of the exact |L(jw)|=1 quadratic; three temperatures. Transients separately use exact 2x2 propagation.
rows.reference_zh: 精确|L(jw)|=1二次方程正根的70位参考，三个温度；瞬态另采用精确2×2传播。
rows.limits_en: Removes interpolation/ODE discretization for the retained linear loop; no dropout, current limit, transistor network or measured phase-margin validation.
rows.limits_zh: 消除既有线性环路的插值及ODE离散误差；未加入压差、限流、晶体管网络或实测相位裕度验证。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Largest unity-crossing frequency sets the scale; the stable positive root is away from the DC-gain-one singular boundary.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。以最大交越频率作为尺度；稳定正根远离直流增益为1的奇异边界。

rows.metric_en: Maximum sampled phase-step error over three damping ratios
rows.metric_zh: 三种阻尼比的最大采样相位阶跃误差
rows.reference_en: 75-digit matrix-exponential Taylor scaling/squaring, 101 times per damping ratio; independent of the new Cayley-Hamilton implementation.
rows.reference_zh: 75位矩阵指数Taylor缩放平方法，每阻尼比101个时刻；独立于新版Cayley-Hamilton实现。
rows.limits_en: Canonical phase-domain response only. PSD quadrature also refined without enlarging saved traces; no transistor VCO, cycle-slip or measured-jitter accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 仅典型相位域响应；PSD积分也细化且不扩大保存曲线，未增加晶体管VCO、周跳或实测抖动准确度。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Maximum saved phase magnitude covers step and overshoot.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。最大保存相位幅度覆盖阶跃与过冲。

rows.metric_en: Maximum periodic mean-output-voltage error across 18 cases
rows.metric_zh: 18个工况的最大周期平均输出电压误差
rows.reference_en: Independent periodic volt-second/charge balance: <Vout>=Vin*D/(1+(Rsw+RL)/Rload)=12 V for the unchanged duty law.
rows.reference_zh: 独立周期伏秒及电荷平衡：<Vout>=Vin*D/(1+(Rsw+RL)/Rload)=12V，沿用原占空比公式。
rows.limits_en: Exact affine propagation and phasewise Gauss integration improve the reduced conduction-only solution. Saved ripple extrema remain sampled; no switching-loss/real-device accuracy improvement.
rows.limits_zh: 精确仿射传播与分段Gauss积分改进仅含导通损耗的简化解；纹波极值仍按保存点取样，不代表开关损耗或实物精度提升。
rows.reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. 12 V output scale multiplied by maximum 2-norm condition number of I-exp(A*T), after scaling states as i/1 A and v/12 V.
rows.reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。12V输出尺度乘以I-exp(A*T)的最大2范数条件数，状态先归一化为i/1A及v/12V。

rows.metric_zh: 导通/关断交叠能量积分误差
rows.reference_en: Closed-form exponential current moments and nonlinear Miller charge/energy primitives; all 18 Vin/temperature cases, both edges.
rows.reference_zh: 指数电流矩与非线性Miller电荷/能量原函数的闭式积分；18种电压/温度、两个边沿。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Display density is unchanged; improved metrics use stage-wise 32-point Gauss quadrature. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 显示密度不变；改进指标按阶段使用32点Gauss积分。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 周期电感伏秒平衡残差
rows.reference_en: Exact piecewise-constant voltage integral is zero by duty construction; all 18 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 占空比构造使分段常数电压积分精确为零；全部18工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Analytical trajectory already at floating-point floor; no meaningful 10% reduction claimed. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 解析轨迹已达浮点误差底限，不宣称有意义的10%降低。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 周期自举最低电压残差
rows.reference_en: Analytical affine cycle-map fixed point versus end-of-run minimum, including finite-cycle settling; all 36 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 解析仿射周期映射不动点与末周期最低值比较，包含有限周期建立残差；全部36工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Exact exponential updates already settle below the stated floor. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 精确指数递推的建立残差已低于给定底限。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 解析RC扰动峰值误差
rows.reference_en: Linear-RC ramp response evaluated with the stable expm1 expression; all 12 weak/strong-receiver cases.
rows.reference_zh: 采用数值稳定expm1表达式的线性RC斜坡响应；全部12种强/弱接收端工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: The peak is analytic already; this does not validate real logic clamps or CMTI. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 峰值已为解析值；这不验证实际逻辑钳位或CMTI。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 导出比较器跳变时刻误差
rows.reference_en: Closed-form one-pole threshold crossing plus the same 35ns assumed propagation delay; all three temperatures.
rows.reference_zh: 单极点阈值交越闭式解加相同35ns假定传播延迟；全部三个温度。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: This improves sampled waveform event placement; the analytic trip_time_s metric was already exact. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 改善采样波形的事件定位；原解析trip_time_s指标已精确。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 首次欠压锁定使能时刻误差
rows.reference_en: Capacitor ramp time Caux*9V/(Istart-Ioff), while original compliance remains inactive; all 18 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 原模型未进入顺从电压限制时，电容斜坡时间Caux×9V/(Istart−Ioff)；全部18工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Event-aligned segments are exact only in the explicitly checked constant-current domain. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 仅在明确检查的恒流工作域内，事件对齐分段解是精确的。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 阻尼耗散能量积分误差
rows.reference_en: Initial minus final stored LC energy from the analytical free response; all 12 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 解析自由响应的初始与末时刻LC储能之差；全部12工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Energy uses Simpson quadrature on a 4x finer internal grid; saved waveform density and analytical physics are unchanged. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 能量采用加密4倍内部网格上的Simpson积分；保存波形密度与解析物理不变。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 总损耗数值计算误差
rows.reference_en: Independent closed-form overlap, exact piecewise-linear RMS moments, same nine loss terms, and bracketed thermal-root bisection; all 18 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 独立闭式交叠能量、分段线性电流的精确均方矩、相同九项损耗及热根区间二分法；全部18工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: No new physical loss term or altered Coss/Qrr accounting. The common thermal node is not a MOS junction. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 未新增物理损耗或改变Coss/Qrr核算；共用热节点不是MOS结温。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 输出电压轨迹最大误差
rows.reference_en: Independent adaptive Dormand-Prince 5(4), tighter run rtol=1e-11/atol=1e-13, continuous ramp and aligned load event; common 10us times, all 18 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 独立自适应Dormand-Prince 5(4)，收紧至rtol=1e-11/atol=1e-13，连续斜坡与对齐负载事件；统一10µs时刻，全部18工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Reference uncertainty is the max difference from a 10x looser tolerance, an empirical convergence estimate, not a rigorous bound. New RK4 uses 0.5us steps and stage-time ramp evaluation; saved traces remain 10us. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 参考不确定度为容差放宽10倍的最大差异，是经验收敛估计而非严格上界。新版RK4采用0.5µs步长并在子步时刻计算斜坡；保存间隔仍为10µs。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

definition_en: 100*(old benchmark error-new benchmark error)/old benchmark error on each stated benchmark. This is not a ten-percentage-point increase in physical accuracy.
definition_zh: 对每项注明的基准，计算100×(旧基准误差−新基准误差)/旧基准误差；并非物理准确率增加10个百分点。
